events.name: Design of Smart Systems using Cloud Based IoT Technologies
events.description: A guest lecture organized by ACE on designing smart systems using cloud-based IoT technologies. The talk was delivered by Mr. Srinivasan Thanukrishnan, Founder & CEO of Glosys Technology Solutions Private Limited.

events.name: Data Analytics
events.description: A guest lecture on Data Analytics organized as part of ACE. It was delivered by Mr. AravindaRajah Rajagopal, Founder of Varsa Infotech, along with Mr. Amith Sethia, a team member at Varsa Infotech.

events.name: Research Careers
events.description: A guest lecture on pursuing careers in research, held as part of ACE. The speaker was Dr. Karthik Pattabiraman, Associate Professor at the University of British Columbia, Canada.

events.name: Career Guidance for Higher Education
events.description: A guest lecture on career guidance for higher education, jointly organized by the Association of Information Technologists and ACE. It was delivered by Mr. Amit Ravindra, General Secretary and Co-founder of Think & Learn (Byju's Learning Classes).

events.name: Emerging Trends in IT and How to Become a Successful Entrepreneur
events.description: A guest lecture covering emerging trends in the IT industry and guidance on becoming a successful entrepreneur. The speaker was Mr. L. Ashok, Founder & CEO of Futurenet Tech, Chennai.

events.name: VR/AR Eco System
events.description: A guest lecture on the VR/AR ecosystem organized by ACE in association with the Department of Information Technology, SVCE. The talk was delivered by Ms. Sheetal Choraria of MAGES Institute of Excellence, Singapore.

events.name: Interrupt'17
events.description: A National Level Technical Symposium organized as part of ACE. Held on a single day, it brought together a technical workshop and multiple guest lectures for participating students.

events.name: Web Development Workshop
events.description: A workshop on Web Development held as part of Interrupt'17, conducted by Computer Science and Engineering students of SVCE for students from other colleges. It was organized by ACE.

events.name: Self-Healing Applications and System Design
events.description: A guest lecture held as part of Interrupt'17 on self-healing applications and system design. The speaker was Mr. S. Avudaiyappan, Director-Projects at Cognizant Technology Solutions.

events.name: Cyber Crime
events.description: A guest lecture on cyber crime held as part of Interrupt'17. It was delivered by Mrs. P C Thenmozhi, IPS, Deputy Inspector General of Police, Kanchipuram Range.

events.name: InheritanceHack
events.description: A 24-hour hackathon organized by ACE in association with International Genetically Engineered Machine-SVCE (iGEM-SVCE) and the Association of Computing Machinery (ACM).

events.name: Coding Competition
events.description: A coding competition conducted by ACE for first and second year students.

events.name: Breast Feeding Awareness Camp
events.description: Girl students took part in a breast feeding awareness camp conducted by the Department of Neonatology, Saveetha Medical College, held during World Breast Feeding Awareness Week.
